title: Admission Eligibility Criteria for First Year and Direct Second Year
content: Eligibility criteria for First Year B.Tech: Candidate must have passed 10+2 / HSC with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biology, or Technical Vocational subjects, securing at least 45% marks (40% for reserved category). For Direct Second Year (DSE), candidates must have passed Diploma in Engineering with at least 45% aggregate.
